retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle cinematic portrait of a lone figure seated in a desert motel courtyard during blue hour, featuring vertically stacked condensed serif typography with atmospheric gradients.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central figure sits in a vintage armchair on cracked asphalt, framed by the symmetrical wings of a desert motel. The lighting transitions from a warm, glowing interior amber to a deep, cool blue twilight sky. Large, vertically compressed serif text floats in the upper third, while secondary text is anchored at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the left and right motel structures framing the central subject
Contrast between the warm artificial lights of the rooms and the cool natural light of the sky
Vertical alignment of the main title, the subject, and the artist name
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of scale and importance for the seated figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located in the lower-middle ground, occupying about 40% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The seated figure and the armchair serve as the primary anchor, supported by the vanishing point of the asphalt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down the central axis to the subject, and finally rests on the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper sky and the foreground asphalt provide significant negative space to balance the detailed architecture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep twilight blue in the sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and gold from the motel interior lights and sunset horizon.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Faded denim blue and neutral tan in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright lights and dark shadows; muted saturation in the landscape with higher saturation in the sky gradient.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a short, elegant leg
The 'G' has a sharp, inward-pointing spur
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent typeface family used at different scales and weights to create unity.
graphicDevices: Soft drop shadows for legibility against the sky

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast verticality and sharp serifs.
Captures the mid-century Americana display feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle photograph of a symmetrical vintage desert motel at dusk. A man in a baseball cap and denim is sitting in a plush armchair in the center of the cracked asphalt courtyard. The sky is a gradient of deep blue to orange. Warm lights glow from the motel windows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the upper sky using a stacked, extra-condensed serif font with a blue-to-light-blue vertical gradient. Add the artist name at the bottom center in a smaller, cream-colored version of the same font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear warm/cool color contrast?

mustRedesign: Do not use modern glass architecture
Do not use flat, non-serif fonts
postGenerationChecks: Verify the text is centered perfectly
Ensure the blue hour lighting feels atmospheric
Check that the serif details are sharp
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Architecture + Low Angle Seated Subject + Blue Hour Lighting + Stacked Condensed Serif Typography
